info.title: ktsu.IconHelper
info.description: A .NET command-line tool for batch-normalizing icon images into a consistent set. Recolours each image to a single-colour silhouette, trims transparent margins, centres the artwork on a square canvas, and resizes it to a maximum dimension with optional padding. Built on ImageSharp with no native dependencies, making it a fast way to unify icon packs collected from different sources.

options.name: --input
options.description:
Required. The path to the directory containing the input
files.

options.name: --output
options.description:
Required. The path to the directory where you want the
modified files to be written.

options.name: --color
options.description:
The color to use for the icon, as a hex value or a known
color name. Defaults to #FFFFFF.

options.name: --size
options.description: The maximum size of the icon. Defaults to 128.

options.name: --padding
options.description:
The number of pixels per size to pad the output image. Must
be < (size / 2). Will not change the output size. Defaults to
0.
